'''Ourim Flu''' was a deadly disease that was known in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:BSP" />

An outbreak of Ourim Flu occurred on several planets in the galaxy sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate intended to take the opportunity of the outbreak to make money by tainting a major shipment of medicinal [[Spice/Legends|spice]] to addict the sick people to their chemicals. However, the scheme was discovered by a man named [[Valance Serth]]. Serth hired a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who destroyed the Black Sun transport carrying the tainted spice.<ref name="SWG:BSP" />
